usage: edgefleet heartbeat <submit|health|history> [flags]

commands:
  submit   receive heartbeats from stdin as a JSON array
  health   query node health from its latest telemetry
  history  list all heartbeats for a node, ascending by seq

input format (submit):
  A JSON array of heartbeat objects; every field is required.
    node          string   node id (non-empty)
    seq           integer  sequence number (> 0)
    collected_at  string   RFC3339 with timezone, e.g. 2026-10-01T12:00:00+08:00
                           must not be later than the receive time
    version       string   version (non-empty)
    height        integer  block height (>= 0)
    missed        integer  cumulative missed duties (>= 0)

  example:
    [{"node":"val-eu-1","seq":7,"collected_at":"2026-10-01T11:59:00+08:00",
      "version":"1.26.0","height":12345,"missed":0}]

flags:
  submit   --data-dir DIR        data directory (default: $EDGEFLEET_DATA_DIR or ~/.edgefleet)
           --receive-time TIME   receive time, RFC3339 (default: now)
  health   --node ID             node id (required)
           --expected-version V  expected version (required)
           --tolerated-misses N  tolerated missed duties, >= 0 (required)
           --missed-since-seq N  count new missed duties since this seq; N must be a
                                already stored positive heartbeat seq, not greater than
                                the latest seq. When provided, the missed-duty alert is
                                based on new missed duties in the interval (strictly
                                greater than N alerts; equal does not). If cumulative
                                missed counts rolled back between any adjacent saved
                                records in the interval, new_missed shows 无法判断 and
                                a 累计漏签数回退 alert is given. The baseline affects
                                only this query.
           --at TIME             query time, RFC3339 (default: now)
           --data-dir DIR        data directory
  history  --node ID             node id (required)
           --data-dir DIR        data directory
